retrievalProfile.description: A high-key studio portrait of a male artist in a cowboy hat, featuring a stark white background and a two-tier typographic layout combining heavy condensed block letters with casual handwriting.
excludeWhen: dark or moody lighting is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, bright studio portrait of a man wearing a white cowboy hat and dark shirt, positioned off-center against a pure white void. The composition is anchored by bold, black typography in the lower-left corner, utilizing a contrast between rigid geometric forms and loose, organic script.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned right-of-center facing the viewer
High-key white background creating sharp silhouette edges
Typography anchored to the bottom-left corner
Contrast between the dark textured shirt and the bright hat/background
coreInvariants: Pure white #FFFFFF background with no visible horizon or floor
Subject wearing a traditional cowboy hat with a visible brim shadow across the upper face
Two-tier text hierarchy with the top line being significantly larger and bolder than the bottom line

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, cropped at the mid-torso.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the brim of the hat serve as the primary focal point, balanced by the heavy text block in the lower left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the face, follows the vertical line of the body down, and settles on the high-contrast text in the corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space on the left side and top, emphasizing the high-key studio look.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Natural skin tones and blue eye color
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation overall, with high local contrast between the subject and the background.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for the primary display text
Secondary text uses a simulated marker-style handwriting with varying pressure
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' characters are elongated vertical ovals
The 'S' has a very tight, compressed curve
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a rigid, industrial sans-serif with a loose, personal handwriting style.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed verticality of the primary text.
Captures the casual, handwritten feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio portrait of a man in a white cowboy hat and dark grey henley shirt, positioned on the right side of a pure white background. Ensure the lighting is bright and even, with a slight shadow under the hat brim.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of left-aligned black text in the bottom-left corner. The top line should be a bold, extra-condensed sans-serif. The bottom line should be a smaller, casual handwritten script.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text extra-condensed and bold?
Is the secondary text a handwritten style?
Is the subject positioned off-center to the right?

mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names or album titles
Do not replicate specific brand logos on the hat or clothing

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on the subject against the white background

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is perfectly left-aligned
Ensure the white background has no gradients or textures
Verify the hat brim shadow does not obscure the eyes completely
Confirm the two distinct font styles are present
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key studio portrait + off-center subject + bottom-left corner-weighted dual-style typography.
